name: wasp
description: Workspace-Aware Spec-based Publisher — an additive layer on top of the bee plugin. Ships /wasp:audit-prep + /wasp:bundle-audit-specs + /wasp:unify-audit-specs + /wasp:pollinate (multi-package monorepo aware, per-package change detection, registry/token/scope validation, ✅ live publish polling, SemVer-correct bumping) + /wasp:cross-pollinate (cross-repository cascade orchestration with dep-graph traversal, topo-sorted serial execution, and downstream dep-pin updates).
